steps.title: Run SOP sections 3‑8
steps.instruction: Execute sections 3 to 8 of the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA SOP, which covers synthesis of first‑strand cDNA through cleanup of ligated fragments.

steps.title: Handle user‑pause interventions
steps.instruction: During the automated run, pause at designated points so the user can perform the manual SOP steps shown in the Opentrons app.

steps.title: Monitor tip depletion
steps.instruction: If the robot runs out of tips, it will automatically pause and prompt the user to refill or replace tip racks before continuing.

steps.title: Set magnetic module height
steps.instruction: Determine the appropriate magnetic engagement height for the plate on the magnetic module (the plate is not in the labware library) and adjust the protocol settings accordingly.

steps.title: Configure reagent volumes
steps.instruction: If a reagent occupies more than one column in the reagent plate (e.g., magnetic beads), set the volume per well based on each sample; otherwise, set a single per‑protocol volume for reagents that occupy only one column.
